title: Bismillah - Upon beginning to eat
transliteration: Bismillāh. And if you forget then when you remember, say: Bismillāhi fī awwalihi wa ākhirih.

title: Dua for food and milk
transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi, wa aṭ'imnā khayran minh. Whomever Allah has given milk to drink, should say: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi, wa zidnā minh.
